def determine_winner(n, rounds):
    scores = {}
    first_max_score_time = {}
    max_score = float('-inf')

    for i in range(n):
        name, score = rounds[i].split()
        score = int(score)

        if name not in scores:
            scores[name] = 0

        scores[name] += score

        if scores[name] > max_score:
            max_score = scores[name]
            first_max_score_time[name] = i

    winner = None
    min_time = float('inf')

    for name, total_score in scores.items():
        if total_score == max_score and first_max_score_time[name] < min_time:
            winner = name
            min_time = first_max_score_time[name]

    return winner

# Read input
n = int(input().strip())
rounds = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]

# Determine and print the winner
winner = determine_winner(n, rounds)
print(winner)
